intro: Nurest recliner is all about effortless comfort—designed with plush support, tech-friendly features, and a stylish build that turns everyday lounging into a truly relaxing experience.

features.title: Recline with a whisper
features.text: Enjoy seamless relaxation at the press of a button—this motorized recliner shifts you into comfort with gentle ease and zero fuss.

features.title: Power where you rest
features.text: Integrated USB ports (A & C) let you charge devices while you lounge, keeping you connected without ever having to get up.

features.title: Pockets of peace
features.text: Side zip pockets provide just the right nook for remotes, books, or chargers—so everything you need is always close by.

features.title: Wrapped in softness
features.text: Microfiber upholstery delivers a soft, warm touch that hugs your body with breathable comfort during every moment of rest.

features.title: Two tones, one elegant story
features.text: The tasteful dual-tone blend of tan peanut creates a warm and sophisticated look that pairs easily with any décor.

name: Nurest Manual 1-Seater Leatherette Recliner With Usb Port
